name: Sonnet dividend growth and income
strategy: Equal-weight basket of high-quality dividend growers and income compounders spanning defensive and cyclical sectors, emphasizing durable cash flows, long dividend growth streaks, and reasonable valuations to outperform the S&P 500 over a 6-month window while providing downside ballast via income and quality.
author: claude-sonnet subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: These are blue-chip dividend aristocrats/kings and near-aristocrats with long histories of consecutive dividend increases, strong free cash flow, and defensive-to-cyclical diversification across healthcare, consumer staples, home improvement, energy, and semiconductors. The mix aims to deliver steady income plus capital appreciation, with lower beta than the S&P 500 offering resilience if markets wobble while still participating in upside from housing (HD/LOW), energy (CVX), and tech-adjacent dividend growth (TXN).
